inputOrigin: Independently constructed chart rectangles, explicit links, peripheral inventory pixels and controlled returned frames; no game trace or native answer.
unannotatedIntermediates: Mixed interior pixels produce inside=None: C in the line and B in the branch. Uniform zero remains a source annotation and would correctly be excluded as an unvisited unrelated node.
qualification: Synthetic component parity only. Cold common integration must use unchanged public rasters and actual returned frames, never an injected component state. An independently supplied synthetic official boundary is not a solved live level.
caseGroups: unique chart geometry, measured inventory, scene hash, independent V5 decoded chart
missing or ambiguous current marker, inventory rows, links and matching target
directed BFS, exclusion, blocked links, same-node empty path and unreachable target
rational addresses, co-located distinct nodes, partial disclosure, multiple markers and evaluation cut
causal gain then local boundary loss and conditional permission
same scene retains stay and arrival alternatives, compatible directions continue
conditional boundary annotation anchor, absent link remains unknown
incompatible directions abstain and ambiguous gain has no occurrence
contrary current anchor refutes predicted arrival and retracts visited/grants
unattributed scene change withdraws location without deleting chart evidence
loss without local context or without disappearance remains unexplained
returned frames: correct boundary, absent, wrong dimensions, foreign pixels, wrong side, pigment retained
zero action budget, unavailable direction, location bound, stale bindings and action-step mismatch
restore, detached states, portable interpretation, current morphology revalidation and epoch reset
DRM priority, distance, action and original-order tie breaking, missing facts and no release authority
counterfactuals: Explicit component-only clones of an already captured original state may remove one explicit chart link, add an already measured grant/visited record, or repeat a location 33 times to isolate its bound. They are marked and never used as cold common inputs.
negativeRasterScope: All registered public rasters are 64x64 and palette 0..15. An empty raster and a single deliberately truncated intermediate frame are component validation negatives only.
normalization: Only source tuples and immutable collections become JSON arrays/objects. No source receipt, digest, evidence or state field is omitted.
sourceIntegrity: Verify the immutable manifest hash and every imported source/control file against that manifest before corpus evaluation and after it. No game implementation or game payload is loaded. Imports and executed source functions are recorded.
